newsitem.title: GREECE: HELLENIC AMERICAN UNION TO HOLD MUSICAL NIGHT.
newsitem.headline: HELLENIC AMERICAN UNION TO HOLD MUSICAL NIGHT.

text.p: The Hellenic American Union will present, on Monday January 13, the exceptional American 50-member music enseble of Monadnock Chorus and Orchestra.
The ensemble originates from New Hampshire and will stop by Athens while on a European tour. The Orchestra's director will be Carroll Lehman and the mezzo-soprano, Pamela Stevens.

The event will take place at the Union's offices in Athens, which are located in Kolonaki, at 22 Massalias Street. Admittance is at 8.30 p.m. local time and is free of charge. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
